asset_action.description: Allows the model to run an asset action block.
schema: Other asset action schemas come from LOADED_SKILLS_CONTENT.
rules: Project actions read only a user-attached .jin-folder. attachment is its file id (omit only if exactly one is attached). Never pass an absolute path as action.path.

project_tree lists relative paths to depth 1..20; tree/search accept offset >= 0 and limit 1..200. Search is case-insensitive literal text, not regex. Narrow path to a subfolder when a scan limit is reached.

project_read returns exact numbered UTF-8 lines, inclusive start/end, at most 400 lines and 24000 characters. Files are limited to 1 MiB. Limits and skipped entries are reported, never silently summarized.
During project review only user-pinned DELAYED reports and their facts are context. Ordinary memory save/update actions remain available. Keep folder links attached unless the user asks to detach.
For other ASSET_ACTION operations, derive concrete schema from LOADED_SKILLS_CONTENT.
